svg.title: From Grok Bot to Botons
svg.desc: A dark terminal-style diagram in three steps. First, Grok Bot, the project manager, with a usage meter that is mostly used up and an amber note: started burning faster, for whatever reason. An arrow asks why not make my own Grok Bot? Second, a document card titled Goal prompt, written with Grok Bot to recreate itself; its lines are abstract bars. Third, Botons: three round, button-shaped bots with antennas in a green panel, a persistent team that is mine, with three settings: models, I choose; tools, I connect; roles, one per Boton. Below, a small figure labelled me, still the CEO: set direction and let them handle the details. A cream arrow carries direction up to the team, and an amber dashed arrow brings back decisions only I can make.
